home.meta.title.message: CloudGround — The hosting panel you run on your own Ubuntu server

home.meta.description.message: One command puts the panel on your Ubuntu server. Every site gets its own cache, its own PHP and its own certificate, plus backups that are restored as a test after every run.

home.hero.lede.message: One command puts the panel on your Ubuntu server. Every site gets its own cache, its own PHP and its own certificate, plus backups that are restored as a test after every run.

home.measures.intro.message: Release v0.1.0 on a small VPS, hit with wrk: three runs per scenario, averaged here. The method and every run are public.

cg.footer.licenseLine.message: Source available under the {license}. Free to run on your own servers.

home.terminal.line1.message: [ok] server checked: Ubuntu, memory, disk, ports

home.hero.kicker.message: A hosting panel for servers you own

home.scope.caption.message: Simulation · a WordPress site under load

home.scope.describeOn.message: With the cache on, response time stays low and flat

home.scope.describeOff.message: With the cache off, response time climbs and swings

home.scope.note.message: A sketch, not a benchmark. The real numbers are in {link}.

home.features.intro.message: Eight things you would normally wire up by hand, one late night at a time. Here they are on from your first site.

home.features.1.title.message: A page cache that purges precisely

home.features.1.text.message: nginx serves pages without waking PHP. Change a post or a price and only the pages that show it are purged.

home.features.2.text.message: Its own system user, PHP and database. A compromised site can’t see its neighbours.

home.features.3.text.message: Every backup is encrypted, stored wherever you choose and restored as a test straight after.

home.features.4.text.message: A password-protected copy of the site. A release slower than production doesn’t ship.

home.features.security.text.message: Plugins with known flaws get flagged and suspicious files get found. Plus 2FA for wp-admin and blocking by country.

home.features.5.text.message: Let’s Encrypt, wildcards included, or bring your own.

home.features.7.title.message: The database, right in the panel

home.features.7.text.message: Tables, rows and SQL, with that site’s permissions and nothing more. No extra tools.

home.features.8.text.message: Admins, operators limited to their own sites, read-only users. Make 2FA mandatory if you like.

home.own.title.message: Stop paying {accent} on your own server.

home.own.a.text.message: Read every line that runs as root on your server. Change it if you need to.

home.own.b.text.message: No licence to renew, no per-server fee. If the project ever stopped, the panel would keep running.

home.own.c.text.message: No account with us, no service in the middle. Backups go wherever you choose.

home.measures.load.message: Load: wrk, on the same server

home.install.step1.message: A fresh Ubuntu 24.04 or 26.04 server and root access.

home.install.step2.message: Run this command. It checks the server before it changes anything.

home.install.step3.message: Open the one-time link, create the admin account, then your first site.
